name: primitives-effects-image-zoom
title: Image Zoom
blurb: Image zooms in on hover or click, scaling smoothly from the pointer position.
description: Wraps an image and applies spring-animated zoom on hover/click. The zoom origin follows pointer position, creating a smooth magnification effect.
use_when: Product galleries, portfolio images, or detail-heavy imagery where zoom magnification aids discovery.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces with no hover (though click zoom is supported).
a11y: Zoom is visual enhancement; alt text and semantic content depend on child image.
